pages.title: Quark Star Core
pages.text: The heart of a star too dense even for neutrons, where the neutrons have dissolved into free quarks. Strange matter may be stable here. It is the densest thing short of a singularity, and holding it makes my wrist ache even through the containment.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the Neutron Star Forge, I compressed a Block of Neutronium with strange matter and supernova remnants, until the neutrons broke apart into quarks. Quark-Gluon Plasma bonded the result together.

Made in $(item)Neutron Star Forge$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Compact Stars.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Cosmic Neutronium Ingot, Dimensional Residue, Hypernova Plasma, Miniature Quasar, Reality Anchor, Stellar Singularity.
